name: drawing-skill
description: Claude draws by hand, mark by mark, from a subject, on a real tldraw canvas.

plugins.name: drawing
plugins.description: Draws a subject by hand on a real canvas, one mark at a time, the way a person would: loose gesture, straight-line block-in, flat colour, then ink, with every stage checked against the subject. No image model. Use when asked to draw, sketch, illustrate, ink, redraw or restyle a picture by hand.
